title: gaylussacia bigeloviana
intro: Gaylussacia bigeloviana, commonly known as Bigelow's huckleberry, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. It is a shrub native to the southeastern United States and is known for its edible blue-black fruits and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Gaylussacia bigeloviana include its potential to help lower blood sugar levels and exhibit antioxidant properties.
